summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow, adding IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust (FUSE/crypto crates) and TypeScript (sdk-core) layers.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves, research + patterns + verification all passed). Execution began sequentially; 58-01 made ~60% progress (Tasks 0–3 committed or staged) before an API socket error killed the executor mid-task, leaving Task 4 (sdk-core JS binding) unstarted and a continuation agent spawned.

repo: `crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client` or `crates/core` — cross-language verify vectors must live in `crates/fuse/tests/` to avoid the dependency cycle.
The GSD `commit_failed` signal from the commit helper is a known false negative — authoritative state must be confirmed via `git log`, not the helper's return value.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` sections require a `(RESOLVED)` marker for `gsd-plan-checker` to pass without warnings; the check is syntactic, not semantic.
Phase 58 locked decisions D-01..D-13 all require explicit coverage across plans; `gsd-plan-checker` validates this.
The local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was already running, enabling 58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate to proceed without manual startup.
AUTO_MODE=true suppresses interactive checkpoints; 58-02 retains one mandatory human checkpoint at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E gate regardless.

workflow: For security/crypto phases, sequential execution on the feature branch is preferable to parallel worktree isolation — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees at the cost of wall-clock time.

When an executor crashes mid-plan, the right recovery is to inspect `git log` + `git diff` to determine exactly which tasks committed vs. staged vs. unstarted before spawning a targeted continuation agent.
Stale mid-edit diagnostics (e.g., 'missing dependency') can appear when the executor crashes during a file write — always verify against actual disk state before acting on crash-time error messages.
Pattern mapper output (PATTERNS.md, 14 files classified) feeds the planner's file-routing decisions and is worth running even for small focused phases.

friction: 58-01 executor hit an API socket error (connection closed) mid-task-4, losing the completion signal and leaving Task 3 uncommitted and Task 4 unstarted — required manual state assessment and a second continuation agent spawn.
The `commit_failed` false negative from the commit helper caused unnecessary uncertainty about whether VALIDATION.md actually committed — required a `git log` verification step.
Plan checker flagged a cosmetic warning (RESEARCH.md missing `(RESOLVED)` marker) that required a manual edit before the phase could be marked clean — minor but adds a cycle.
Crash-time diagnostic incorrectly reported `ciborium` missing from `crates/fuse/Cargo.toml` (it was already present at line 43), which could have triggered an unnecessary re-add.
